summary: Lincoln International, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the execution of agreements (Fourth A&R LPA, Tax Receivable Agreement, Voting Agreement) in connection with its IPO. The filing also describes the issuance of Class B and Class C common stock to limited partners and controlling partners in exchange for nominal consideration, as part of the IPO structure. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present; this is a routine current report related to an IPO and associated internal reorganization.
